text: 🇲🇽⚖️ Only Mexicans — with no second passport — may lead Mexico. "Every Mexican who wishes to be president, governor or head of government must be only Mexican — hold no other nationality, nor have acquired one." — Claudia Sheinbaum, presenting the reform, Aug 27 Sheinbaum sent Congress a constitutional reform (Articles 82, 116, 122): candidates for president, governor and head of government must renounce any other nationality before registering, and may not invoke a foreign passport or another state's protection in office.

🏭🇲🇽 <u>MEXICO EXPORTS LIKE NEVER BEFORE</u>

Mexican exports hit an all-time record $81.4 billion in July, up 43.7% year-on-year, with manufacturing up 45.7% and electrical/electronic goods soaring 134%, INEGI reported. Non-oil exports to the US jumped 49.8%. Mexico's January–July trade surplus now stands at $9.26 billion — nearly eight times the $1.18 billion booked in the same period of 2025.

✊🇲🇽 <u>ANGELA DAVIS AT UNAM: DESPAIR IS NOT AN OPTION</u>

Over 2,000 people packed UNAM's Centro Cultural Universitario to hear Angela Davis: "Despair is not an option," she told the overflowing hall, calling the "primary task of radical activists" the generation of hope against rising fascism. Davis and Gina Dent closed the night with a statement of solidarity for Palestine — in the heart of Latin America's largest public university.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>MEXICO CITY STANDS WITH PALESTINE</u>

This Saturday, Aug 30, Mexican collectives fill Mexico City's Teatro del Pueblo for "Palestine: Genocide, Apartheid and Resistance," hosting Jamal Juma' of the BDS National Committee and BDS Latin America coordinator Germán Romano. The aim, organizers say, is to "denounce the formal structures of discrimination and dispossession." Brigada Sumud and allied groups open the day with the Coro La Coraza choir.

🌽🇲🇽 <u>MAYA COMMUNITIES WIN: PROBE THE GLYPHOSATE IN OUR WATER</u>

Mexico's Supreme Court unanimously sided with 17 Maya communities in Hopelchén, Campeche, ordering SEMARNAT, CONAGUA and COFEPRIS to investigate glyphosate contamination in their water. The court set a precautionary standard rooted in Indigenous rights: "the State cannot wait for absolute scientific certainty about possible environmental damage before beginning prevention." The communities first sued back in 2020.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>THE COURT TO THE OPPOSITION: YOU'RE NOT MEXICO</u>

Mexico's electoral court (TEPJF) ordered the new right-wing party "Somos México" to drop its name, logo and colors by Aug 31, ruling that claiming to be Mexico amounts to a "symbolic appropriation of national identity" — no single faction gets to brand itself as the whole nation. The party says it will comply "under protest," calling it an "outrage." Sheinbaum backed the ruling: a party is not the country.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>PAN EX-GOVERNOR'S FUEL-THEFT EMPIRE UNRAVELS</u>

Mexico's FGR found two hidden Mexico City warehouses tied to Ernesto Ruffo Appel — the PAN's first-ever governor — full of import permits and contracts that simulated a fuel-smuggling ring moving stolen gasoline from the US. Ruffo and 24 others are under investigation; nine are already jailed. The man the right sold as its clean-government pioneer now anchors the huachicol fiscal probe.

August 26, 2026 | 🔴

📰 A video of 5-year-old Liam Tadeo in tears beside his handcuffed father — stopped Aug 16 in Austin on the way to a soccer game — ended with ICE deporting both to Mexico. Attorneys say ICE refused the father's plea to release the boy to his US mother. 💀

The father accepted removal rather than stay detained with his son, even though the child's other parent was available the whole time.
